repos.description: 科技爱好者周刊，每周五发布
repos.summary_zh: 《科技爱好者周刊》是阮一峰团队推出的科技内容周刊，每周五发布，聚焦前沿科技趋势、AI应用、创业洞察与行业动态，内容涵盖人工智能、互联网经济、软件开发等领域，兼具深度与可读性，是科技从业者与爱好者的重要资讯来源。
repos.summary_en: The Tech Enthusiast Weekly is a curated publication by Ruan YiFeng, releasing every Friday with in-depth coverage of emerging technologies, AI advancements, startup insights, and industry trends, targeting tech professionals and enthusiasts seeking actionable intelligence.

repos.description: ⭐AI-driven public opinion & trend monitor with multi-platform aggregation, RSS, and smart alerts.🎯 告别信息过载，你的 AI 舆情监控助手与热点筛选工具！聚合多平台热点 +  RSS 订阅，支持关键词精准筛选。AI 智能筛选新闻 + AI 翻译 +  AI 分析简报直推手机，也支持接入 MCP 架构，赋能 AI 自然语言对话分析、情感洞察与趋势预测等。支持 Docker ，数据本地/云端自持。集成微信/飞书/钉钉/Telegram/邮件/ntfy/bark/slack 等渠道智能推送。
repos.summary_zh: TrendRadar 是一款 AI 驱动的舆情监控工具，支持多平台热点聚合、RSS 订阅与智能关键词筛选，提供 AI 翻译与分析简报推送。集成微信/飞书/钉钉等 8+ 通知渠道，支持 Docker 部署与 MCP 架构，赋能 AI 对话分析、情感洞察与趋势预测，30 秒快速部署。
repos.summary_en: TrendRadar is an AI-powered public opinion and trend monitoring tool that aggregates multi-platform hot topics, RSS feeds, and offers smart keyword filtering. It delivers AI-translated analysis briefs via 8+ notification channels (WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk, etc.), supports Docker deployment and MCP architecture for AI-driven sentiment analysis and trend forecasting, with a 30-second setup.

repos.description: Independent technology for modern publishing, memberships, subscriptions and newsletters.
repos.summary_zh: Ghost 是一个现代化的开源 Node.js 内容管理系统（CMS），专为独立创作者、会员订阅和新闻通讯设计。它提供强大的发布工具、会员管理和订阅功能，支持无头架构，可灵活集成前端框架。核心优势包括简洁的编辑器、SEO 优化、自动化工作流和 Ghost(Pro) 托管服务，适合个人博客、媒体网站及内容变现平台。
repos.summary_en: Ghost is a modern, open-source Node.js CMS designed for professional publishing, memberships, subscriptions, and newsletters. It offers a clean editor, SEO tools, and headless architecture for flexible front-end integration. With features like automated workflows and Ghost(Pro) managed hosting, it's ideal for creators and publishers seeking a developer-friendly, scalable platform.

repos.description: 前端精读周刊。帮你理解最前沿、实用的技术。
repos.summary_zh: 前端精读周刊是一个深度技术分享平台，聚焦前沿前端技术解析、源码解读与工程实践，涵盖React、JavaScript、编译原理等核心领域，结合大厂经验提供高质量技术洞察，助力开发者提升工程能力。
repos.summary_en: Frontend Weekly is a premium technical publication that delivers in-depth analysis of cutting-edge frontend technologies, including React, JavaScript, and compilation principles. It combines insights from industry experts to provide practical engineering knowledge and elevate developer capabilities.

repos.description: An all-in-one email service platform powered by Cloudflare  | 基于 Cloudflare 的一站式邮箱服务平台  | Cloudflare Email 邮箱 Mail
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Cloudflare Workers 构建的轻量级邮箱服务，集成 Resend 邮件发送、R2 附件存储与 D1 数据库，支持多用户管理、权限控制及数据可视化。采用 Vue3 + Element Plus 实现响应式界面，通过 Turnstile 人机验证保障安全，提供 API 接口与邮件推送功能，显著降低自建邮箱成本。
repos.summary_en: A lightweight email service built on Cloudflare Workers, integrating Resend for email delivery, R2 for file storage, and D1 for database operations. Features multi-user management, RBAC permissions, responsive UI with Vue3/Element Plus, Turnstile anti-bot protection, API endpoints, and data visualization via ECharts, offering a cost-effective self-hosted email solution.

repos.description: CloudFlare free temp domain email 免费收发 临时域名邮箱 支持附件 IMAP SMTP TelegramBot
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Cloudflare Workers 构建的免费临时邮箱服务，支持收发邮件、附件处理、IMAP/SMTP 协议及 Telegram 机器人通知，采用 Rust WASM 实现高性能邮件解析，提供现代化多语言响应式界面，支持邮箱地址密码保护，完全免费且无需服务器部署。
repos.summary_en: A fully-featured free temporary email service built on Cloudflare Workers, supporting email sending/receiving, attachments, IMAP/SMTP protocols, and Telegram bot notifications. Uses Rust WASM for high-performance email parsing, offers a modern responsive UI with multi-language support, and enables password protection for email addresses—all at zero cost with no server required.

repos.description: 专注批量推送的小而美的工具，目前支持：模板消息-公众号、模板消息-小程序、微信客服消息、微信企业号/企业微信消息、阿里云短信、阿里大于模板短信 、腾讯云短信、云片网短信、E-Mail、HTTP请求、钉钉、华为云短信、百度云短信、又拍云短信、七牛云短信
repos.summary_zh: WePush 是一款专注于批量消息推送的轻量级工具，支持微信公众号、小程序、企业微信、短信平台（阿里云、腾讯云等）及邮件等多种渠道。具备变量消息、定时推送、用户导入、多账号管理等功能，提供可视化界面与推送历史管理，适用于营销通知、系统告警等场景。
repos.summary_en: WePush is a lightweight tool for bulk message pushing, supporting WeChat official accounts, mini-programs, enterprise accounts, SMS platforms (e.g., Alibaba Cloud, Tencent Cloud), and email. It offers variable messaging, scheduled delivery, user import, multi-account management, and a user-friendly GUI, ideal for marketing alerts and system notifications.

repos.description: ShadowsocksR update rss, SSR organization https://github.com/shadowsocksr
repos.summary_zh: ShadowsocksR C# 版本4.8.0 是一个全能代理工具，支持Socks4/4a/5、HTTP协议，具备节点统计、连接管理、UDP-over-TCP、多重代理及自定义协议插件功能。支持服务器订阅与自动更新，提供GPG签名校验确保安全性，适用于绕过网络限制与隐私保护。
repos.summary_en: ShadowsocksR C# v4.8.0 is a comprehensive proxy tool supporting Socks4/4a/5, HTTP, with features like node statistics, connection management, UDP-over-TCP, multi-hop proxying, and custom protocol plugins. It supports server subscription with GPG signature verification for security, ideal for bypassing censorship and enhancing privacy.

repos.description: A cute temporary email service built with NextJS + Cloudflare technology stack 🎉 | 一个基于 NextJS + Cloudflare 技术栈构建的可爱临时邮箱服务🎉
repos.summary_zh: MoeMail 是一个基于 Next.js 和 Cloudflare 技术栈构建的可爱临时邮箱服务，提供隐私保护、实时邮件接收、灵活有效期设置、主题切换、PWA 支持等功能，支持自建部署、邮件发送、Webhook 通知及 OpenAPI 访问，界面简洁友好，适合个人或团队使用。
repos.summary_en: MoeMail is a cute temporary email service built with Next.js and Cloudflare, offering privacy protection, real-time email receipt, flexible validity periods, theme switching, PWA support, and self-hosting capabilities. It supports email sending, webhook notifications, OpenAPI access, and a user-friendly interface for personal or team use.

repos.description: Outlookmail Plus: Designed Specifically for Registration  |  Outlookmail Plus：专为注册而生  |
repos.summary_zh: OutlookMail Plus 是一款专为注册流程设计的邮箱管理器，聚焦验证码提取、临时邮箱管理和自动化注册场景。支持多邮箱类型（IMAP/OAuth/GPTMail）、批量导入分组、正则提取验证码链接，并提供受控API接口供自动化系统调用，同时集成Telegram通知与邮件推送能力。
repos.summary_en: OutlookMail Plus is a specialized email manager designed for registration workflows, focusing on verification code extraction, disposable email management, and automated account creation. It supports IMAP/OAuth/GPTMail accounts, batch import/grouping, regex-based code parsing, and offers controlled API endpoints for automation integration with Telegram/email notifications.

repos.description: outlookEmail 支持 Outlook/Hotmail、Gmail、QQ、163、126、Yahoo、阿里邮箱以及自定义 IMAP 邮箱，同时集成 GPTMail、DuckMail、Cloudflare Temp Email 多提供商临时邮箱能力
repos.summary_zh: 多邮箱邮件管理工具，支持 Outlook OAuth、Microsoft Graph API 和 IMAP 协议统一读取管理 Outlook/Gmail/QQ/163/Yahoo 等主流邮箱，提供 Web 界面实现分组代理、别名转发、临时邮箱集成及对外 API 调用，具备缓存优化、批量操作和安全防护能力。
repos.summary_en: Multi-email management tool supporting Outlook OAuth, Microsoft Graph API and IMAP protocols to unify access to Outlook/Gmail/QQ/163/Yahoo accounts. Features web interface for group-based proxy routing, alias forwarding, temporary email integration, and external API with caching, batch operations, and security protections.

repos.description: 🎯 精选 RSSHub 实用路由推荐，让你的 RSS 阅读更高效！
repos.summary_zh: 精选高质量 RSSHub 路由与官方 RSS 源，涵盖 AI、科技媒体、安全、前端开发等垂直领域，提供一键导入 OPML 文件功能，支持在线搜索分类浏览，显著提升 RSS 阅读效率。
repos.summary_en: Curated high-quality RSS feeds and RSSHub routes covering AI, tech media, security, frontend development, etc., with one-click OPML import, online search and categorization for efficient RSS reading.

repos.description: 临时邮箱 - 匿名的一次性邮箱（无需登录，打开即用）
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Golang + Astro + React 构建的匿名临时邮箱服务，支持长轮询实时接收邮件、CSS样式隔离、暗色主题切换及附件下载，无需登录即可快速注册保护隐私，适用于防垃圾邮件和批量账号注册场景。
repos.summary_en: Anonymous disposable email service built with Golang, Astro, and React, featuring real-time email delivery via long polling, CSS isolation, dark mode, and attachment support—ideal for privacy protection and spam-free account registration.

repos.description: 同步豆瓣标记条目到 Notion/NeoDB
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库实现豆瓣标记数据（看过/听过/读过）通过RSS订阅同步至Notion数据库和NeoDB平台，支持自动抓取条目详情、评分、短评等信息，并通过GitHub Actions定时执行，适合个人知识管理。
repos.summary_en: This repository enables syncing Douban marked entries (watched/listened/read) to Notion databases and NeoDB via RSS, automatically fetching details like ratings and reviews using GitHub Actions for scheduled updates.

repos.description: Self-hosted temporary email platform with SMTP receiving, verification code extraction, domain management, and API access.
repos.summary_zh: ShiroMail 是一个自托管的临时邮箱平台，支持实时 SMTP 邮件接收、验证码自动提取、域名管理、API 访问及管理员控制台。基于 Go + Gin + React + MySQL/Redis 构建，提供完整的邮箱生命周期管理、消息解析规则配置和自动化接口，适用于需要临时邮箱验证或测试的场景。
repos.summary_en: ShiroMail is a self-hosted temporary email platform featuring real-time SMTP ingestion, verification code extraction, domain management, API access, and an admin console. Built with Go, Gin, React, and MySQL/Redis, it offers full mailbox lifecycle control, message parsing rules, and automation APIs for testing or validation workflows.

repos.description: 基于 Cloudflare Workers + D1 的临时邮箱控制台。接收邮件后，根据可配置的正则规则自动提取关键数据（如验证码），并通过 API 对外提供查询能力。
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Cloudflare Workers + D1 的无服务器临时邮箱系统，支持自动接收邮件、正则规则提取验证码等关键信息，并提供 RESTful API 查询接口。具备白名单过滤、邮件转发、定时清理及可视化控制台管理功能，适用于自动化验证与数据采集场景。
repos.summary_en: A serverless temporary email console built with Cloudflare Workers and D1, automatically receives emails, extracts key data (e.g., verification codes) via configurable regex rules, and exposes a RESTful API for querying. Features include sender whitelisting, email forwarding, cron-based cleanup, and a web admin console for management.

repos.summary_zh: Yarb 是一个每日资讯聚合工具，整合36氪、知乎日报、雪球等主流内容源，提供科技、产品、投资等领域精选文章与热点话题，帮助用户高效获取一手信息。
repos.summary_en: Yarb is a daily news aggregator that curates content from sources like 36Kr, Zhihu Daily, and Xueqiu, delivering curated tech, product, and investment insights to help users stay informed efficiently.
